items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: The owner's name was Joe Morris; it was called Joe Morris' Plantation.

ctx.x: And Eddie Heywood downstairs... Just activity. It was full of activity. On Central Avenue, they had several after-hour places also. Around 29th they had the Jungle Room. And the thing was Jack's Basket Room.

Also, out on the south end, around 97th and Central Avenue, they had a club that played big bands. And that's where I heard Billie Holiday again. It was called the Plantation. The owner's name was Joe Morris; it was called Joe Morris' Plantation. And when Billy Eckstine came to town with his band, that was the first place they played, was at the Plantation.
